nicole.k: Noticed leads bouncing between owners during this morning's spike. opening thread to avoid a noisy weekend.

ben: any pattern? hubspot duplicates or our claim flow?

samir: sample: lead-789 assigned->A at 09:42:11, assigned->B at 09:42:18, assigned->C at 09:42:30. enrichment arrived 09:42:55.

nicole.k: sounds like splay too narrow. current splay=3s, claim timeout=7s. propose splay=25s, lease=20s for non-vip.

ben: +1. Also suggest bypass for high-intent tags ("paid-trial", "enterprise") so SLA unaffected.

ops-bot: alert: claim-service errors spiked 0.2% last 10m.

samir: plan: nicole to push config toggle to staging, run 20m synthetic test, then 5% canary tomorrow 11:00 PT. ben will add tag-based bypass list. ops-bot, add alert for reassigned_count>3 within 60s.

nicole.k: will open PR with config and test steps. ETA PR by 3pm. thanks.
